subject.en: Title: Year of the Worlds Trailblazer

body.en: Dear friend! This year a new attraction awaits you at the Winter Resort. You can ride a Roc and hunt at the same time! Come to our beautiful resort and test your accuracy. My assistant Che-Go will show you everything.

Our world is rich in mysteries, both amazing and horrible. Few can penetrate them, but I believe you are among the chosen ones. You have a history of unearthing secret knowledge - your log contains notes about that. Alas, no one has heard from you in a long time. Are there any new details since then?

subject.en: Who will reveal the world's mysteries?

subject.en: Urgent News from Julia Lemkova of Jigran

body.en: The letter contains a message from the Great Mage of the Arisen, Nefer Ur. He asks you to peruse the contents of the infocube attached to the message.
Dear friend! We have run into something most unusual. You have to see it with your own eyes. Please come see me at the Observatory. It's time for decisive action!

Hello!

It's time to make another step in our fight against Nihaz. You didn't think it would be easy, did you?

Everything in this world is not going as planned, and now I need your help again.

As I thought, they will try to stop us. Fortunately, you've dealt with our enemy's schemes before, so I think you can handle it.

Want to know more? Find me on Gipat, in the Village.
The letter orders you to travel to the capital and see the Head of your state.

Hello, Stormbringer.

Please come to Polis as soon as possible. I need to talk to you in person.

Greetings. Our situation in Eden continues to deteriorate.

It is necessary to continue diplomatic efforts to arrange negotiations with the All-Mother. Additionally, our scouts report a large concentration of warriors of the so-called "Old Tribe". They might be a threat both to us and the Children.

Come to Eden as soon as possible. Complete negotiations with the All-Mother.

My dear !

Since you are currently busy with the assault on Nihaz's Citadel, I am forced to order you to postpone this task until later. As far as I know, right now your forces are holding their positions and will continue to do so, but a full-blown assault requires preparation. This pause is quite welcome.

The problem the Empire is facing bears no delay. The matter is urgent and rather delicate.

I order you to visit me in Yasker's Tower as soon as possible.

body.en:
Dear friend, I'm one of those who keeps track of all your adventures. It's time for a new one. I will not tell you all the details yet, only that you need to visit the leader of your people. If you are a brave warrior of the League, go see Aidenus. And if it's the Empire, go see Yasker. And if the fate wasn't kind to you, and you belong to the elven race, then Marianne awaits you. Make haste, my friend, and hear the latest news form them.

P.S. I attached the intercepted letter from the leader of your people.

body.en: Go to Dane, now! Find me in the Silver Valley, near Winter Palace. This is important! Don't show this letter to anyone.

Hello, Stormbringer.

The Observatory is gaining strength and every day reaches farther and farther through time and space. I wish I could accelerate this process, but this doesn’t seem to be likely.

Anyway, right now the Observatory is ready to send you to a new... adventure, I suppose.

I’ll be waiting for you in my domain.

Hello, my friend!
The time has come, and we meet again.
Do you want to learn the truth about the Cataclysm, the Great Mages, Dragons and the true meaning of the Revelation?
These mysteries will change your perception of the world! I'll be waiting for you at the Crossroads. You have been granted a leading role in my new play. It will change Sarnaut forever!
P.S. Just to remind you: use the Ancient June Portal on Gipat to travel to the Crossroads. Hurry up! I'm not going to wait forever!

Hello. You already know that the Wormfaces and Draconids betrayed me. I hate betrayers! You are going to teach these fools a lesson. As a reward, I will share my great knowledge with you.
Travel to my Citadel and meet my Voice who will guide you further.
Greetings, hero. I have an urgent assignment, upon which the fate of our country might depend. I will wait for you in my tower. Don't keep me waiting!

Hello from the other world! Ha ha!

You thought I was a goner when my Cuttlefish crashed in the woods because of that vampire? Yeah, right!

I was dead for a while, but an old buddy of mine that works for a guy in the Purgatory pulled me out. So I'm alive and well.

And I found a note in my pocket - one I grabbed at the Border Outpost while I was looking for the evidence you needed. And I remembered you. So I decided to write to you.

The note was a strange one. There's some gibberish on the back. I didn't understand a thing, but maybe you can.

Well, goodbye! I'll get myself a new ship – perhaps we'll meet again in the Astral.
The letter orders you to travel to the capital and see the Head of your state.
You must return to Jigran at once to meet me. Important news have arrived from Nefer Ur, but I will tell the details when we meet.
The letter says that your presence is required in the capital. Something very important must have happened!
The letter says that the governor of the Iron City wants to see you. Something very important must have happened!
The letter says that you need to come to the capital center immediately. Something very important must have happened!

I found a very interesting artifact the other day. Do you remember what I told you about Incarnations? Then check this out: a real Aoidos Spark! It can turn you into an Aoidos - one of those who appeared in our world after the gods died. What do you think?

If you forgot everything I taught you about Incarnations, find me in the Master's Residence, and I will refresh your memory. Or you can also talk to the Experts in the Inexplicable in the faction capital; they are pretty informed, too.

Well, see you.

Klavdia.
Are you ready to accept a special challenge of Dionic Games, Stormbringer? Complete every Dominus' challenge! Prove yourself worthy of the reward!

Hello! On mild spring days everybody wants to change their wardrobe and cheer themselves up with a new outfit or cape. But we at the Holiday Committee decided to cheer you up and give you a few gold coins, which you can use to buy whatever your heart desires!

We all remember the deed of the great martyrs that gave their lives for Sarnaut. Even after their death the fallen Great Mages protect all of us, giving their Patronage to selected heroes. And so that you can honor their great sacrifice, we are giving you some marvelous incense. Burn it to show your respect for your Patron! We will never forget those to whom we owe our very existence!

We have all seen Dreadnoughts, but not all of us have been so lucky as to take a ride on this technical wonder... until now!
The Great Mages have decided to cheer up all the heroes of Sarnaut and have created an exact copy of a real combat Dreadnought. In the next few days anybody who wants to can try out the power of the offensive combat machine, created using ancient June technology. Unfortunately, Dreadnought copies created using magic disappear after a few days, but during that time the land of Sarnaut will tremble with their menacing tread! Enjoy the "Dreadnought War" and good luck!

Good day to you, hero.

It's been a while since you've seen your class trainer. Things have changed since then.

We are glad to inform you that your lost items have been recovered. We return them and wish you good luck in your travels!

Remember that Lost Property Office is always at your service!
Unfortunately, your spouse is asking for divorce. We wish you all the happiness you can find in the future!

The best way to win a beautiful lady's heart is doubtlessly a strong embrace. Mind you, I don't mean hugs and cuddles. I mean manly carrying her in your hands! It involves certain sense of balance and acrobatic skills. Here's a brief manual, describing how to do it. Study it carefully. If you happen to lose it, come by, I'll give you another one.

Good day!

First of all, let me congratulate you on surviving the battle with the Architects.

It is my duty to inform you that we have finally studied the cloning system and received answers to all our questions. You may find it interesting that this technology was initially developed on Ferris without the use of any otherworldly materials. The Object - or the Sculptor - provided the energy source for this miracle of engineering thought. That is why all clones, including pseudo-Herbert and pseudo-Elena, turned into modificants so quickly. Their high intelligence shows that the process of creation a living being from scratch went smoothly, but the deleterious impact of the Sculptor turned out to be deadly.

Most likely, Tep had learned the cloning technology together with the unknown to us principles of matter and energy manipulation after his visit to Ferris.

Sarn, the "Master" of the cultists, took high interest in the researches of Tep and his acolytes. This is how the cloning technology passed from Tep to the cultists' leader - Gorluxor. Comparing their cloning systems proves our theory true.

So, that is it. Thank you for all your efforts in securing our expedition. Murk is looking forward to another adventure like that one and asked me to tell you, I quote: "If you don't call on me next time you fight these hunhurrs, I'll kick the hell out of you!"

Yours respectfully,

Zayan.

P.S.: Herbert and Elena have departed together to an unknown location. I know that most likely they will never be seen anywhere in the League or the Empire territories again. I don't want to disturb their happiness, but if you meet them one day, tell them that they are always welcomed here.

Hello! I'm glad you are following the path of learning. I heard you have completed many great deeds, proving your worth to our kin.

Please take these Water of Death Droplets as a reward for your accomplishments. They will help you to move along the glorious path you have chosen!

Greetings!
You have long been into the mysteries of our world. You have performed a lot of great deeds and grand exploits, proving your class to be the best among all the Sarnaut's people!
I beg you to kindly accept this reward from me - the Water of Death. Be it of help in your further explorations.

Greetings! You have long been questing to understand our world, step by step, mission after mission, all the while showing your allegiance to our class - the best in Sarnaut! Your great deeds will go down in the history of our country!

In recognition of your performance, please accept these Water of Life Droplets. I hope that they will help you in your adventures.

Hello! Please don't throw this letter away! This is not the propaganda of the Trinity Church, nor an advertisement for a new Elven magazine. This is an invitation to a play. The performance should be very exciting, but the results will depend on you. As the saying goes, "all the world's a stage", and you are to be the main actor!
In order to reach the play, please use the mystical stone enclosed within the letter. It will teleport you to the stage. There we can get to know each other better and you can embark on the Path of the Chosen One! I promise that you'll find out some very interesting information when you finish it. I also guarantee that the show will include some amazing adventures! See you soon!
- The Director

Dark days have come for Umoir, friend... First the Leper came, now the undead are rioting. We don't have much resources to keep protecting our land... We won't last long.

The cause of our misfortune is hidden deep in the Ancient Mound. The undeat and the Leper are coming out from there. There's an ancient Demon deep down there, that's what the wise men say. As long as we're alive, we have to fight it. I'm only afraid we won't stand for too long, not without help, anyway.

Hi!

You are probably waiting for this letter? Have you forgotten about our investigation on Suslanger with your heroic deeds?

Alas, I had some difficulties, so I don't have any good news for you. I need your help, so come by when you can. See you soon.

Hi, buddy! I'm not good at writing letters, so I'm sorry if I'm doing this wrong! There's something that should interest you. It's about the worm, darn it! We've had enough of it. So we decided to deal with it once and for all. Want to learn more? My sister Reya the Merciless will explain all the details. Anyway, come over here, we'll tell you everything!

! Hello, hello! It's so strange writing a letter to someone! And it will be delivered somewhere outside of Isa! Incredible!

We have put things in order after the Urun attack, and now we can offer you all sorts of tasks! Broddie wants to protect Skalgard, the Thread Keepers see different predictions, and my brothers and I want to join the Winter Watch! And everyone needs your help, so come back soon!

And don't think we'll just make you run around for nothing. You will be rewarded, of course! The Smile and Nutlet Families are working on that, in fact! You'll see what we have, and there is a little advance attached to the letter for you!

I believe you've been waiting for word from me for some time, ...

The time has come. The barricades at the exits from the city have been removed - Hirkalla's guards have driven off most of the distorted creatures.

It means we can move on - if you remember, we still need to find five more "odd people out" whose fates have been stolen.

Please, hurry – the sooner we continue our search, the greater our chances of success.
